module-1-ros2/advanced/index.title: Advanced ROS 2 Topics

module-1-ros2/index.title: Module 1: The Robotic Nervous System (ROS 2)
module-1-ros2/index.description: Welcome to the first module of your robotics learning journey. In this module, you'll explore ROS 2, the middleware that serves as the nervous system for robot control.

module-1-ros2/intro.title: Module 1: The Robotic Nervous System (ROS 2)
module-1-ros2/intro.description: Introduction to ROS 2 as the communication middleware for humanoid robots

module-1-ros2/middleware-concepts.title: ROS 2 Middleware Concepts
module-1-ros2/middleware-concepts.description: Middleware is the software layer that enables communication between different components of a robot system. In ROS 2, this is accomplished through a publish-subscribe model and service-based communication.

module-1-ros2/nodes-topics-services.title: Nodes, Topics, and Services
module-1-ros2/nodes-topics-services.description: In this section, we'll explore the core communication mechanisms in ROS 2: nodes, topics, and services.

module-1-ros2/practical/setup.title: ROS 2 Practical Setup and Implementation
module-1-ros2/practical/setup.description: Hands-on guide to implementing ROS 2 systems for humanoid robotics

module-1-ros2/rclpy-bridge.title: rclpy Python Agent Bridge
module-1-ros2/rclpy-bridge.description: rclpy is the Python client library for ROS 2. It provides Python bindings for ROS 2, allowing Python developers to create ROS 2 nodes and interact with the ROS 2 ecosystem.

module-1-ros2/summary.title: Module 1 Summary: ROS 2 - Robotic Nervous System
module-1-ros2/summary.description: Summary of ROS 2 concepts and implementation for humanoid robotics

module-1-ros2/theory/core-concepts.title: ROS 2 Core Concepts and Architecture
module-1-ros2/theory/core-concepts.description: Fundamental building blocks of ROS 2 systems for humanoid robotics

module-1-ros2/urdf-humanoids.title: URDF for Humanoid Robots
module-1-ros2/urdf-humanoids.description: URDF (Unified Robot Description Format) is an XML format for representing a robot model. For humanoid robots, URDF describes the physical structure, joints, and kinematic properties.

module-2-digital-twin/advanced/index.title: Advanced Simulation Techniques
module-2-digital-twin/advanced/index.description: Advanced simulation methods and optimization for complex humanoid robotics applications

module-2-digital-twin/environment-design.title: Environment Design
module-2-digital-twin/environment-design.description: Creating realistic environments is crucial for effective simulation and digital twin applications. In this section, we'll explore environment design principles for robotics simulation.

module-2-digital-twin/index.title: Module 2: The Digital Twin (Gazebo & Unity)
module-2-digital-twin/index.description: Welcome to the second module of your robotics learning journey. In this module, you'll explore digital twins through physics simulation and environments using Gazebo and Unity.

module-2-digital-twin/intro.title: Module 2: The Digital Twin (Gazebo & Unity)
module-2-digital-twin/intro.description: Introduction to digital twins and simulation environments for humanoid robotics

module-2-digital-twin/physics-simulation.title: Physics & Collision Simulation
module-2-digital-twin/physics-simulation.description: Physics simulation is the foundation of digital twins, enabling realistic modeling of robot interactions with the environment. In this section, we'll explore physics simulation in Gazebo.

module-2-digital-twin/practical/world-cr.title: Practical World Creation and Environment Setup
module-2-digital-twin/practical/world-cr.description: Hands-on guide to creating and testing simulation environments for humanoid robots

module-2-digital-twin/sensor-simulation.title: Sensor Simulation (LiDAR, Depth, IMU)
module-2-digital-twin/sensor-simulation.description: Sensor simulation is critical for robotics development, allowing algorithms to be tested with realistic sensor data before deployment on physical robots.

module-2-digital-twin/summary.title: Module 2 Summary: Gazebo & Unity - Digital Twins
module-2-digital-twin/summary.description: Summary of simulation environments and digital twin concepts for humanoid robotics

module-2-digital-twin/theory/world-creat.title: World Creation and Environment Modeling
module-2-digital-twin/theory/world-creat.description: Creating realistic simulation environments for humanoid robot testing and development

module-2-digital-twin/unity-rendering.title: Unity High-Fidelity Rendering
module-2-digital-twin/unity-rendering.description: Unity provides advanced rendering capabilities that enable high-fidelity visualization for robotics simulation. This section explores Unity's rendering features relevant to digital twin applications.

module-3-isaac/advanced/index.title: Advanced GPU Acceleration and AI Integration
module-3-isaac/advanced/index.description: Advanced techniques for GPU acceleration and AI integration in humanoid robotics

module-3-isaac/index.title: Module 3: The AI-Robot Brain (NVIDIA Isaac)
module-3-isaac/index.description: Welcome to the third module of your robotics learning journey. In this module, you'll explore NVIDIA Isaac, which provides perception and motion intelligence for robots.

module-3-isaac/intro.title: Module 3: The AI-Robot Brain (NVIDIA Isaac)
module-3-isaac/intro.description: Introduction to NVIDIA Isaac for perception and motion intelligence in humanoid robots

module-3-isaac/nav2-locomotion.title: Nav2 for Humanoid Locomotion
module-3-isaac/nav2-locomotion.description: Navigation 2 (Nav2) is the ROS 2 navigation stack that provides path planning and navigation capabilities. For humanoid robots, Nav2 requires special considerations for locomotion and mobility.

module-3-isaac/practical/gpu-acceleratio.title: Practical GPU Acceleration for Robotics
module-3-isaac/practical/gpu-acceleratio.description: Hands-on guide to implementing GPU-accelerated perception and AI systems using NVIDIA Isaac

module-3-isaac/summary.title: Module 3 Summary: NVIDIA Isaac - AI Robot Brain
module-3-isaac/summary.description: Summary of AI integration and NVIDIA Isaac concepts for humanoid robotics

module-3-isaac/synthetic-data.title: Isaac Sim Synthetic Data
module-3-isaac/synthetic-data.description: NVIDIA Isaac Sim is a robotics simulation application that provides photorealistic simulation capabilities and synthetic data generation for training AI models.

module-3-isaac/theory/gpu-accelerated-pe.title: GPU-Accelerated Perception Systems
module-3-isaac/theory/gpu-accelerated-pe.description: Implementing high-performance computer vision and sensor processing using NVIDIA Isaac and GPU acceleration

module-3-isaac/vslam-navigation.title: Isaac ROS VSLAM & Navigation
module-3-isaac/vslam-navigation.description: NVIDIA Isaac ROS provides GPU-accelerated perception and navigation capabilities for robotics applications. This section covers Visual Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (VSLAM) and navigation systems.

module-4-vla/advanced/index.title: Advanced Vision-Language-Action Systems
module-4-vla/advanced/index.description: Advanced techniques for multimodal AI systems in humanoid robotics

module-4-vla/humanoid-interaction.title: Role in Humanoid Interaction
module-4-vla/humanoid-interaction.description: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models play a crucial role in enabling natural and intuitive interaction between humans and humanoid robots. This section explores how VLA models enhance humanoid robot capabilities.

module-4-vla/index.title: Module 4: Vision-Language-Action (VLA)
module-4-vla/index.description: Welcome to the fourth and final module of your robotics learning journey. In this module, you'll explore Vision-Language-Action models, which represent the cutting edge of multimodal reasoning and behavior in robotics.

module-4-vla/intro.title: Module 4: Vision-Language-Action (VLA)
module-4-vla/intro.description: Introduction to multimodal reasoning and behavior for humanoid robotics

module-4-vla/real-world-applications.title: Real-World Applications
module-4-vla/real-world-applications.description: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are being deployed in various real-world applications, transforming how robots interact with complex environments and human users. This section explores practical implementations and use cases.

module-4-vla/summary.title: Module 4 Summary: Vision-Language-Action Systems
module-4-vla/summary.description: Summary of VLA systems and multimodal AI for humanoid robotics

module-4-vla/theory/multimodal-integrati.title: Vision-Language-Action Systems
module-4-vla/theory/multimodal-integrati.description: Creating integrated perception-action systems that understand and respond to human commands

module-4-vla/vla-concepts.title: VLA Concept Overview
module-4-vla/vla-concepts.description: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models represent a paradigm shift in robotics, where perception, language understanding, and action execution are unified in a single model architecture.

overview/welcome.title: Welcome to robot.ai
overview/welcome.description: Welcome to robot.ai, a comprehensive learning platform for humanoid robotics education. This platform combines ROS 2, simulation, AI, and multimodal systems to provide you with a complete learning experience.
